about_the_game:
《Wonderland》— Forge Your Own Fantasy Tactics Legend!

Explore a world of swords and sorcery, and build your unique adventurer’s guild!

◆ Immersive Fantasy World
Step into the continent of Elphar and pursue the legendary Nine Sanctuaries!
▸ Boost vitality in mechanical ruins, unlock divine gear through lost gates—each sanctuary holds power to reshape destiny.
▸ Explore perilous ruins, solve ancient puzzles, and conquer guardians to claim rare gear and epic materials!

◆ Revolutionary Freeform Build System
"No Class Restrictions"—Your Weapon, Your Destiny!
✅ Dynamic Skill System: Skills evolve with weapon type and mastery—switch freely between Warrior, Assassin, or Mage paths.
✅ Deep Talent Tree: Unlock hundreds of talents through progression and customize your growth path.
✅ Affix Crafting: Enchant gear, lock rare attributes, and combine them to create game-breaking combat styles!

"From rookie to legend—every step is yours to define."

◆ Strategy-First Tactical Gameplay
Wisdom decides life or death; terrain turns the tide!
▸ Assemble 4-hero squads tailored to missions with class and terrain tactics.
▸ Dynamic Success Rate: Squad level/gear/stats affect outcomes. High-risk S-rank missions—timed and unique!
▸ Guild Co-op: Deploy members to solve puzzles, charge foes, or heal allies in brain-teasing yet thrilling turn-based battles!

◆ Living Guild Ecosystem
From a rundown tavern to continental dominance—your leadership rules all!
✅ Recruitment: Monthly refresh of unique characters—recruit and train rising stars with gold.
✅ Resource Management: Triple-currency economy (Gold/EXP/Prestige)—strategically allocate gear and potions.
✅ Guild Progression: Unlock shops, forges, and training grounds. Rise in prestige to access elite quests!

"Fire underperformers. Train superstars. Forge your golden team!"

◆ Rich Content & Challenges
Dynamic Quest Network: Hunt werewolves, chase thieves, explore the Dream Eater’s Labyrinth… Quests refresh randomly.

Nine Sanctuaries Challenge: Unlock training grounds and forge systems upon clearing—craft legendary gear!

◆ Key Features
Talent & Gear DIY: Freely combine affixes + talents to discover hidden builds.
Deep Character Progression: Starting Q&A determines base stats; weapon mastery unlocks ultimate skills.
Dynamic Economy: Gold buys supplies, Prestige unlocks S-quests, EXP levels heroes—resources interlock!
detailed_description:
An Invitation to New Players

“1,000 gold coins, an empty tavern—this is your start.

Recruit your first member, take on E-rank quests, and forge your legend amidst clashing swords and magic…

One day, your guild will stand atop the sacred peaks of Elphar!”
